longDescription:
PlainHygiene is a reference library of practical, sourced hygiene guidance — 1,088 features across 18 topics, from WHO's 6-step handwashing technique to menstrual health, food safety, disaster sanitation, and caregiving for kids, elders, and people with chronic conditions.

Every fact is drawn from public health authorities: the World Health Organization, the CDC, UNICEF, USDA, OSHA, EPA, FDA, FEMA, the Sphere Association, and similar bodies — with citations you can check yourself, right in the app.

### What's Inside
• Handwashing & hand hygiene (WHO's 6-step technique, a guided timer, hand sanitizer guidance)
• Menstrual & reproductive hygiene
• Food hygiene & safe handling
• Body & personal hygiene
• Sanitation infrastructure & waste management
• Life-stage hygiene: infants, kids, teens, pregnancy, elders
• Low-water, disaster & emergency hygiene
• Disease prevention & hygiene science
• Household, laundry & environmental hygiene
• Occupational & workplace hygiene
• Travel, outdoor & camping hygiene
• Pet, animal & zoonotic hygiene
• Community, school & public-space hygiene
• Special populations, disability & chronic-condition hygiene
• Culture, language & localization notes
• A full reference library & glossary

Plus routine-building, reminders, and habit-tracking tools to turn any of this into a daily practice — at your own pace, with no streak-shaming.

### A Note on What This App Is
PlainHygiene is educational hygiene guidance, not medical advice — it's not a substitute for professional medical advice or local public-health guidance. If you have a health concern, talk to a qualified professional.
whatsNew: New: Apple Health support for handwashing. Optionally save every timer wash to Apple Health and count the washes your Apple Watch detects, all kept on your own devices. New one-tap Wash Timer on Apple Watch (watch face complication and Action Button), and the Watch app can now be installed straight from your watch. Bug fixes and improvements.
